name: quotaview
description: Streams sanitized local Codex activity events to the QuotaView macOS app.

interface.shortDescription: Private local activity bridge for QuotaView.
interface.longDescription: Writes a minimal, sanitized stream of Codex lifecycle events for the QuotaView macOS activity island. No prompts, commands, files, responses, credentials, or network uploads are collected.
defaultPrompt: Explain what QuotaView activity data stores.
